prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, sign-in hint, and sign-in redesign changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Warning Hint: Display a explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to use their original authentication method so pets are not reset. (why: Support logs show 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, suggesting users unintentionally create duplicate accounts.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Checklist Redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen into a checklist layout with a visual progress bar to ensure clear custom pet image submissions. (why: Adoption step drops conversion to 60.9% (89s median), and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect.)
2: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Background Notification: Enable optional ready notifications and a delayed tip carousel on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: The waiting step has a long median time of 201s (mean 2336s), and users report app stalls or confusion about pet appearance.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Centered Layout Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen to a centered layout with clear button actions to prevent screen stall confusion. (why: Support tickets noted sign-in screens stalling or failing to load, causing 27.1% drop-off at this step.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Card Progress Layout: Reformat the choose path screen to a card layout with active step counters and time estimates. (why: Path selection takes a mean of 514s; providing structured step counts helps set clear completion expectations.)
5: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Seal Layout: Transform the adoption certificate screen to a story scroll layout featuring an official seal badge component. (why: Reinforcing emotional attachment at the adoption stage can reduce drop-off before reaching the desktop home step.)
6: [home, layout] Waiting Generation Progress Bar: Update the waiting screen to a checklist layout with an embedded progress indicator component. (why: The waiting step has high mean time (2336s) and causes user confusion regarding whether pet generation is active.)
